analysis.executive_summary: Documentation audit of okteto.com/docs crawled 2,139 pages with 100% coverage across the site. 23 confirmed broken internal documentation links require immediate remediation. API reference coverage stands at 53.7% across 332 detected API pages, indicating significant documentation gaps. Only 11.97% of pages display last-updated metadata, severely limiting freshness transparency. Overall audit confidence is 86.88%, with link verification confidence at 83.46% due to 3 unverified URLs blocked by authentication or rate limits.
strengths: Complete crawl coverage achieved: 100% of in-scope documentation pages indexed (2,139 pages)
Single-product topology provides clear documentation structure and navigation model
API pages successfully detected (332 pages) enabling quantitative coverage analysis
Example code reliability estimated at 79.91%, indicating generally functional code samples
Trap URL detection prevented 180 false positives from skewing link quality metrics
risks: 23 confirmed broken internal documentation links degrade user experience and SEO authority
API reference coverage at 53.7% leaves nearly half of API surface undocumented or poorly linked
Freshness metadata present on only 11.97% of pages prevents users from assessing content currency
SEO/geo issue rate of 6.72% may impact discoverability in search engines and international markets
3 unverified links due to authentication/rate-limiting create blind spots in link integrity assessment
Link verification confidence at 83.46% indicates moderate uncertainty in external link health
Example reliability at 79.91% means approximately 1 in 5 code samples may fail or mislead users

prioritized_actions.action: Repair all 23 confirmed broken internal documentation links
Expand API reference documentation to achieve minimum 80% coverage of detected API surface (currently 53.7%)
Implement last-updated timestamps on all documentation pages (currently 11.97% coverage)
Audit and fix example code reliability issues affecting ~20% of samples
Resolve SEO/geo issues affecting 6.72% of pages to improve search discoverability

limitations: External audit cannot verify 3 URLs blocked by authentication, rate limits, or server restrictions; actual broken link count may differ
Crawl cannot assess accuracy, completeness, or technical correctness of documentation content itself
API coverage metrics depend on automated detection patterns; manual API inventory may reveal different coverage gaps
Example reliability is estimated through static analysis; runtime execution in actual user environments not tested
Audit reflects point-in-time snapshot; documentation and link health may change immediately after assessment
